Introducing Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted 🤗

We adapted Qwen's model specifically for the pi coding agent using reinforcement learning and a LoRA adapter.

The results, measured as pass@1:
🚀 SWE-bench Pro (Hard 51): 29.4% → 62.7%
💻 Terminal-Bench 2.1: 39.5% → 55.8%
⚡ 55–62% fewer tool calls per task

This is the power of open models: you can adapt them to YOUR tools and YOUR use cases. Let’s build! 💛

Today we open-source the Robotics for @antigravity plugin, one of the best tools available for roboticists to go from 0 to execution, powered by Gemini Hydrogen @GoogleDeepMind .

The plugin is a set of skills you can install on Antigravity. It allows to do anything you can imagine with robots: from asking it to install and calibrate new arms, to creating complex simulations and robot behaviours zero-shot

In this demo, we asked it to create from scratch a program that can play chess with a Franka Duo. It created the sim environment, the control and calibration code, and finally translated it to the real robot. It was all created by Hydrogen, that even plays the game live, thinking of all the moves.
